name: Copper/Gold Ratio & S&P 500 Forward Returns
description: Analyzes the copper/gold ratio (HG/GC futures) as a leading indicator for S&P 500 (SPY) 3-month forward returns. Regime defined by 60-day rate of change of the ratio: positive ROC = rising (risk-on), negative ROC = falling (risk-off). Shows ratio colored by regime, average 3M SPY returns + hit rates by regime, and a summary stats table.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COPPER/GOLD RATIO & S&P 500 FORWARD RETURNS
# =============================================================================
# Question: Does a rising copper/gold ratio predict better S&P 500 returns?
#
# Regime: 60-day ROC of HG/GC ratio > 0 = Rising (risk-on)
#                                    <= 0 = Falling (risk-off)
# Forward return horizon: 63 trading days (~3 months)
#
# Chart 1: Copper/gold ratio colored by regime (Blue=rising, Gray=falling)
# Chart 2: Grouped bars — avg 3M SPY return + hit rate by regime
# Chart 3: Summary table — N, Median, Hit Rate, Best, Worst per regime
# Event markers: Regime flip events (ROC crosses zero)
#
# Assets:
#   - market_data_source (SPY-Stocks, 1D) — primary
#   - reference_futures (HG) + futures_continuation — copper
#   - reference_futures (GC) + futures_continuation — gold
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary: SPY ---
spy_src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
spy_close = spy_src.c

# --- Reference: HG Copper futures ---
hg_raw = reference_futures(ticker='HG')()
hg = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)

# --- Reference: GC Gold futures ---
gc_raw = reference_futures(ticker='GC')()
gc = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)

# --- Copper/Gold Ratio ---
# NoAdjustment preserves true price relationships for cross-commodity ratio (D16)
# ffill both legs to handle any calendar misalignment
hg_close = ffill(hg.c)
gc_close = ffill(gc.c)
cg_ratio = hg_close / gc_close

# --- Regime: 60-day ROC of ratio ---
# roc() outputs decimal fraction (e.g., 0.05 = 5% gain)
ratio_roc_60 = roc(period=60)(cg_ratio)
is_rising = is_valid(ratio_roc_60) and ratio_roc_60 > 0
is_falling = is_valid(ratio_roc_60) and ratio_roc_60 <= 0

# --- Regime flip detection for event markers ---
# crossover/crossunder on the ROC vs zero
roc_crosses_above = crossover(ratio_roc_60, 0)   # falling → rising
roc_crosses_below = crossunder(ratio_roc_60, 0)  # rising → falling
regime_flip = roc_crosses_above or roc_crosses_below

# Regime label for event marker badge
regime_label = 'Rising' if roc_crosses_above else 'Falling'

# --- Ratio colored by regime ---
ratio_rising = where(is_rising, cg_ratio)
ratio_falling = where(is_falling, cg_ratio)

# --- SPY 3-month forward returns (63 trading days) ---
spy_fwd_63 = forward_returns(period=63)(spy_close)

# --- Forward returns filtered by regime ---
fwd_rising = where(is_rising, spy_fwd_63)
fwd_falling = where(is_falling, spy_fwd_63)

# --- Hit rate: 1.0 if positive return, 0.0 if not (ternary for correct Mean) ---
# Guard with is_valid to handle NaN at end of series (last 63 bars)
hit_rising = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_rising) and fwd_rising > 0) else 0.0
hit_falling = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_falling) and fwd_falling > 0) else 0.0

# Sparse hit rate: only defined on regime bars (NaN on off-regime bars)
hit_rising_sparse = where(is_rising and is_valid(spy_fwd_63), hit_rising)
hit_falling_sparse = where(is_falling and is_valid(spy_fwd_63), hit_falling)

# Timestamp for x-axis
bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Event Markers: Regime Flip ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Copper/Gold Regime Flip',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='New Regime', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge,
                       card_color_map={'Success': ['Rising'], 'Error': ['Falling']}),
            ColumnSpec(title='Ratio ROC (60d)', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cu/Au Ratio', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(regime_label, ratio_roc_60, cg_ratio, regime_flip)

# --- Chart 1: Copper/Gold Ratio colored by regime ---
xy_lines(
    title='Copper/Gold Ratio: Does Risk Appetite Signal Stock Returns?',
    category='Copper/Gold Regime',
    y_axis_label='Cu/Au Ratio (HG/GC)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Rising (ROC > 0)', color=Color.Blue, area=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Falling (ROC ≤ 0)', color=Color.Gray, area=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, ratio_rising, ratio_falling)

# --- Chart 2: Grouped bars — avg 3M return + hit rate by regime ---
# Grouped mode: stack= defines x-axis categories (Rising / Falling)
# name= defines legend entries (Avg 3M Return / Hit Rate)
# 4 inputs: rising_return, falling_return, rising_hitrate, falling_hitrate
xy_bars(
    title='Does Rising Copper/Gold Predict Better SPY Returns?',
    category='Copper/Gold Regime',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Value',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Avg 3M Return', color=Color.Blue, stack='Rising'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Avg 3M Return', color=Color.Gray, stack='Falling'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Hit Rate', color=Color.Sky, stack='Rising'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Hit Rate', color=Color.Slate, stack='Falling')
    ]),
    order=2
)(fwd_rising, fwd_falling, hit_rising_sparse, hit_falling_sparse)

# --- Chart 3: Summary stats table — N, Median, Hit Rate, Best, Worst ---
# Standard mode: each cell is a separately computed metric
# Row 0 = Rising regime, Row 1 = Falling regime
# Cols: N | Median 3M Ret | Hit Rate | Best | Worst
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='3-Month SPY Return Stats by Copper/Gold Regime',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['Rising (ROC > 0)', 'Falling (ROC ≤ 0)'],
        col_headers=['N (Obs)', 'Median 3M Ret', 'Hit Rate', 'Best 3M', 'Worst 3M'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: Rising
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 1: Falling
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='Copper/Gold Regime',
    order=0
)(
    fwd_rising, fwd_rising, hit_rising_sparse,  fwd_rising,  fwd_rising,
    fwd_falling, fwd_falling, hit_falling_sparse, fwd_falling, fwd_falling
)
